scope: Read-only source/profile investigation; production code, installed jars and GitHub unchanged.

spark.note: Inclusive call paths overlap. Stack-without-VSS is not module-exclusive self. Only Render thread was sampled.

sourceReference.packedMeshDifference: Java-version-compatible clamp expressions; no production synchronization performed in this investigation.

notes: Current-pass counters and frame-reset indirect upload counters are snapshots, not cumulative deltas.
FPS snapshots use a rolling window of up to 90 frames; snapshot median is not the recording average FPS or 1% low.
quadsCurrentPass is candidate-range count before GPU filter; GPU results may be stale and exclude direct fallbacks.
Resident quads include source and appended display alternatives; additional display storage is capped at 50% of opaque source.
Gpu timestamp stages and batch/build/filter intervals have different units and can be nested; do not sum them.

limitations: No matched same-scene Voxy-only FPS/GPU/quad benchmark.
No post-change benchmark: only analysis artifacts were created.
No complete same-frame category/ownership/Hi-Z/direct geometric census.
Parent and child presence in draw lists does not establish duplicate visible pixels.
Sprite material count is not a vegetation count.
Only selected Voxy shaders were verified against the installed jar, not the entire Java binary.
Forge source review is not a Forge-client performance recording.
